messages.subject: [OGRUG] GPU Acceleration in R
messages.body_plain:
Dear John,

Dear OGRUG members,

 

John - As promised, I invite OGRUP to host a session at U of Quebec. Please
let me know if you have room in your calendar for mid-January.

 

All - I’m looking for R users to briefly present some projects that may have
implemented (or even just tried or considered) GPU Acceleration in R.

 

In any case, my research team is planning to test GPU acceleration in R,
using CULA on Nvidia Tesla K20.

 

http://brainarray.mbni.med.umich.edu/brainarray/rgpgpu/

 

If your organization has some funds available, we need partners to help us
finance this research. Tesla K20 cards are $3000, and I have a couple of PhD
students available to work with us on this.

 

Thanks and looking forward to your reply.

 

Best Regards,

 

Stephane 

 

_________________________________________

Stéphane Gagnon, Ph.D.

Professeur

Département des sciences administratives

Université du Québec en Outaouais

Pavillon Lucien-Brault

101, rue St-Jean-Bosco, Local B2082

C.P. 1250, succursale Hull 

Gatineau, Québec, Canada, J8X 3X7

Téléphone: +1-819-595-3900, poste 1942

Fax: +1-819-773-1747

Email: stephane.gagnon at uqo.ca  

Web: http://www.gagnontech.org <http://www.gagnontech.org/>
